# Linear provider schema fixture

Unmodified public Linear SDK GraphQL SDL from https://github.com/linear/linear/blob/2a3ac4cfd28af84b98c439efa74b1e32b2ce985b/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql (commit `2a3ac4cfd28af84b98c439efa74b1e32b2ce985b`), retained with its upstream MIT license. Downloaded 2026-10-05. Tests validate the actual adapter documents and input coercion against these provider-owned types before answering localhost HTTP requests. No provider credentials or customer data are included.
